text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
The Turbo Call! See, when I win, I wanna<n>have
everyone call my name, just like<n>King!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Repeating one's name and praising<n>oneself
prompts the fans to follow along.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
A first-rate runner's first-rate call will<n>captivate
fans and show them what to<n>do. ♪

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
The fans? Psh. You don't need to do a<n>
demonstration.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Just say, "Shut up and follow me."<n>They'll be as
good as lemmings.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Hehe, not half bad... Silence, and follow<n>my lead!
